Tharoor, Banerjee Criticize Detention of Ankita Bhandari's Parents

Congress leaders Shashi Tharoor and Abhishek Banerjee have criticized the detention of the parents of Ankita Bhandari. Tharoor stated that the "power to detain is not power to silence," while Banerjee slammed the BJP over the issue. The specific reasons for the parents' detention and the circumstances surrounding it are not detailed in the provided coverage.
